reviewed_by: Codex focused dependency review for Vitest 4.1.11
reason: The update changes the Vitest runner and mocker. Eight collected tests across a plain unit module and jsdom hook module exercise assertions, mocks, fake timers, and React rendering under the new runner; npm ci and the production build passed locally.
exclusions: No application source or operator workflow behavior changed. Python, native, and Playwright are excluded. Real-Core, LAN-origin, browser/device, and full suites are outside this test-tool update and no operator workflow support is claimed from this selection.
